rerank._comment_first_stage: iter #186: paper Table 1 lists 8 first-stage retrievers (BM25/SPLADE/BGE/E5/MiniLM/STAR/ANCE/ColBERTv2) + 1 LLM reranker (DeepSeek-v4 Reranker). DEFAULT_FIRST_STAGE_RETRIEVERS=['bge','e5'] chosen because dense retrievers have cached embeddings across all 3 domains.
